title: Unwelcome Guests
start: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre of Fort Forinthry.

ironman.t: 40 Woodcutting (If chopping maple logs for the planks)

kills.t: Parts of the quest will have you building in places where more fetid zombies are located. You do not have to kill them, but should be able to withstand their attacks.

rewards.t: Ability to build all three tiers of the Fort Forinthry Guardhouse and Grove.
The Raptor will operate as a Slayer master inside Fort Forinthry.
Access to the crypt north of Fort Forinthry, containing two new slayer monsters:

steps.t: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre at Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 2 Talk about 'Unwelcome Guests'. › Accept]
Talk to the Raptor, west of the Command Centre.
Go to the northern gates and open them. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head west and slay ten fetid zombies.
Talk to the Raptor located south-west of the Fort once back inside.
Talk to Bill. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Unwelcome Guests'.]
Leave via the northern gates into the Wilderness. [Chat: 1 Yes, I understand the restrictions.]
Fully construct defences at the building supplies along the walls. Turning off auto-retaliate is recommended, otherwise construction will be interrupted when you are attacked.

sub.t: Three just outside the western walls of the fort.
Two just outside the northern walls of the fort.
One just outside the eastern walls of the fort.

p: Siv and the Raptor watching the newly built guardhouse

steps.t: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre. [Chat: 2 Talk about 'Unwelcome Guests'.]
Talk to Bill. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Unwelcome Guests'.]
Start building the Guardhouse at the Fort Forinthry blueprints table.
Head to the Guardhouse near the Raptor.
Build at the Construction hotspots within the Guardhouse until it is complete.

sub.t: Players can speed up this process by building at the optimal Construction hotspots.

steps.t: Talk to the Raptor or Overseer Siv to trigger a dialogue and watch the cutscene.
Go to the northern gates and open them. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head west and slay another ten fetid zombies.
Talk to the Raptor at the Guardhouse.
